primer: Aurobindo Pharma is an integrated global generics, API, Pen-G fermentation, and biologics/CDMO platform. It generated ₹33,653 Cr in FY26 sales and a record ₹10,263 Cr in Q2 FY27, backed by 113% 10-year CFO-to-PAT conversion and ₹3,002 Cr net cash. However, 12.9% ROCE, 326-day inventory, and active USFDA Warning Letters at Eugia Unit I and III keep business quality conditional. At ₹1,845.70 (26.1x P/E) against a ₹1,880.00 base target (0.13:1 R/R at CMP; 0.79:1 at support), new capital is REJECTED on VALUATION, while the 15 Zerodha shares remain HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP at ₹1,585.12.
